events.text: Just... looking around.

These planks look smashable. HYAAA!
That loot is coming with me. Let me just check something first.

A waystone! I can see the waystone!

No paint, but a button is a button. *boop*

One drop of yellow. Bold.
No yellow... but the waystone is RIGHT THERE.
Quest objective, here I come.
Waystone attuned. Progress saved. I can rest now.

profile.intro: Loot goblin. Wanders off to explore everything and won't leave a single shiny thing behind.
